Women's Premier League Bowling Data

wpl_bowling.Rd

Women's Premier League Bowling Data

Usage

data("wpl_bowling")

Format

A tibble with 476 rows and 7 columns:

season

Season label as given by Cricsheet (the first WPL season is labelled "2022/23")

bowler

Bowler's name, as written by Cricsheet (initials and surname)

bowling_team

Team the bowler played for

phase

Phase of the innings, a factor: Powerplay (overs 1-6), Middle (overs 7-15) or Death (overs 16-20)

balls

Legal deliveries bowled (wides and no-balls excluded)

runs_conceded

Runs charged to the bowler: runs off the bat plus wides and no-balls. Byes and leg byes are not charged.

wickets

Dismissals credited to the bowler. Run outs and retirements are not counted.

Source

Cricsheet, https://cricsheet.org/. Match data licensed under ODC-By 1.0.

WPL bowling by season, bowler and phase of the innings

Ball-by-ball data from the Women's Premier League (WPL), summarised for each bowler, in each season, in each phase of the innings.

Cricsheet, https://cricsheet.org, downloaded with the cricketdata package. Please credit Cricsheet if you reuse these data.

Details

Super overs are excluded. The data are built by the script data-raw/wpl-bowling.R.
